notes.title: Update: Bean Battles v2.13
notes.content:
[p][b]💉Attention Beans 💉[/b]

I hope everyone is having a nice day! This patch contains a new Item: Stim! Run faster, jump higher, shoot faster, and reload faster! With some mild side effects. Also there will be 3x XP and Coins as well as an exclusive title for the next few weeks! Full patch notes:

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b] 
[/p][p]- New Item Stim: Run faster, jump higher, shoot faster, and reload faster! With some mild side effects.   

[previewyoutube=bXUkcTPsEB8;full][/previewyoutube]

- Nerf BCR: Damage 12>10, Reload Time 1s > 1.5s, Fire rate .08 > .085, Horizontal recoil, .2 > .3

 - Nerf C4: Close Range: 10>7, Long Range: 37 > 32 (same as grenade). The C4 is now louder in the air and will become quieter once it lands. You are now also able to shoot the C4 which reduces the damage/range by half! (shotgun buff?)

- Matchmaking update: Updated the match functionality to use the new server, better for future updates and should help NAT issues. Also added the ability to set custom ports to help for users port forwarding. 

- Katana half damage is now a toggle in weapon options. 
[/p][p][b]COSMETICS[/b]  
[/p][p]- Community hoodie: Three new hoodies! Congrats to Hudd, fishlol, and the The Bean League!

- New title: A new event title "Performance Enhancer" available for the next few weeks!

[b]OTHER / BUG FIXES[/b]  

- Fixed weird UI behavior bugs in the menus.

- Made some fixes to localization.

- Added Helpful tips for NAT issues and added the ability to use a custom port in the settings.

- Other Small Fixes  

If you find any issues or bugs, let me know. Also, make sure to join the official Bean Battles Discord to keep up with all things Bean Battles! [url="https://discord.gg/cK2rCdw"]DISCORD[/url].  Have fun![/p]

notes.title: Update: Bean Battles v2.12 - Beanmas ☃️🎄‼️
notes.content:
[b]Merry Beanmas, Beans ☃️🎄‼️[/b]

I hope everyone is having a nice holiday season! The Beanmas event is now active in Bean Battles. Hop on and get 3x XP and Coins as well as an exclusive title! Patch 2.12 also comes with a new weapon, new cosmetics, updates to events, localization, and more! It's been a while since we've had a new weapon, so I'm excited to see what you guys think:

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]

- New Weapon BCR: A new assault rifle that is deadly at all ranges!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33289668/e80aaa186b525db483aa225379868cdbce688b39.png[/img]

- Update to Events: Events got reworked! Pretty much, it means there will be more, and they come with special rewards! Beanmas is currently active. While it is, you will get 3x XP and Coins and an exclusive title if you play during the event.

- Map Updates: Some more Easter eggs and fan art around the map.

[b]COSMETICS[/b]

- Skins: Four new Beanmas cosmetic items are now available! You will only be able to purchase these during the event, so get them while you can!

- Christmas Lights
- Nutcracker
- Snowman
- Ice Skates

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33289668/843da3ade0ebe79d404a007069a2e4c00169b191.png[/img]

- Event Titles: I've added a few new event titles! If you launch Bean Battles while these are active, you will get them for free!

- Icons: A few community icons have been added. Thank you, everyone, for all the fan art! Some of these and other art are being added to the Steam Point Store as well. If you'd like to add art to the game or Steam Point Store, please contact me on Discord.

[b]OTHER / BUG FIXES[/b]

- Localization: Finally added support for languages other than English! This was a surprising amount of work and might not be perfect. If you notice any issues or incorrect translations, please let me know. :)

- Update to Server: Backend got some updates, mainly to support the new events.

- UI Updates: Updated the UI to support the new event features as well as localization.

- Other Small Fixes

If you find any issues or bugs, let me know. Also, make sure to join the official Bean Battles Discord to keep up with all things Bean Battles! [url=https://discord.gg/cK2rCdw]DISCORD[/url].

Have fun!

notes.title: Update: Bean Battles v2.10
notes.content:
[b]Hello Beans,[/b]

This patch contains server side changes, branding, and a new website! In terms of content, there is not a ton, but this is something that I've been working on for a while and is a stepping stone to many future Bean Battles updates:

[b]SERVER / WEBSITE[/b]

- Updated Server: Made some major changes to the server side of Bean Battles. The main goal of this is to eventually change how networking works(no more incompatible Nat type). This also helps connect Bean Battles Users stats with steam better to prevent peoples stats getting reset.

- New website: Gupa Games/Bean Battles now has a website! Now I will have a place to centralize accounts/news/and other content. [url=https://gupagames.com/]gupagames.com[/url]

[b]OTHER / BUG FIXES[/b]

- Steam Point Shop: A few months ago I created a steam point shop for Gupa Games (Bean Battles). I planned on adding various fan art, but sadly lost my discord account as well as the art. If you already submitted art to me, or are interested in having your own art on the steam point shop, please follow the process explained [url=https://gupagames.com/news/65c6ed77c90961328276feaf]here.[/url]

- Fixed issues with the Leaderboards as well as removed various hackers.

- Added branding(Gupa Games) to various parts of Bean Battles.

- Updated some frameworks related to steam and networking.

- Other small fixes

If you find any issues or bugs let me know! I plan on having patches and content a lot more often moving forward(goal of every monthish). I have a lot of things planned but also want to hear your ideas! Please comment suggests below of head on over to the discord and post them there! [url=https://discord.gg/cK2rCdw]https://discord.gg/cK2rCdw[/url]

Have fun!

notes.title: Update: Bean Battles v2.03
notes.content:
Hey guys

This patch has a lot of QOL changes and bug fixes. It also comes with a change to weapon spawning, so its more consistent to find weapons.

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]


- Unfinished matches: Now when a match ends early, players receive XP and coins for the rounds played.

- Recent players: Recent players will now show up in Steam's recent players section.

- Weapon spawn rework: The exact details of this one is a bit confusing but overall weapon spawning should feel more constant. The spawns are no longer completely random. Some numbers have changed for spawn rates but overall it should feel the same.

- Character menu: The arrows to swap between various cosmetics finally don't move.

- Server side: A lot of server side changes to help performance and keep it more secure.

[b]COSMETICS[/b]


- Slight modifications on a few skins.

[i][u]NEW TITLES[/u][/i]


- Bean Bash Champion

- RBBL Season 0 Champion

[b]OTHER / BUG FIXES[/b]


- Gas Bug: Fixed the bug where your camera would get stuck on the the gas grenade.

- Weapon spawns: This has to do with rework. Weapons were spawning in at the incorrect rate in later rounds. Mainly the sights which was also causing performance issues.

- Performance: Other small performance issues involving the grid.

Thank you everyone for all the support and ideas. Hopefully everyone is enjoying the start of their summer. If you're interested in playing competitive Bean Battles make sure you check out the official [url=https://discord.gg/cK2rCdw]DISCORD[/url]. 

Have fun!

notes.title: Update: Bean Battles v2.02
notes.content:
Hey guys

Today's patch is focused more on the competitive side of Bean Battles and helping out the various groups that run tournaments/leagues:

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]

- Tournament Match: In a tournament match you can now pause matches. Also DC’d players team/score/wins will be remembered upon re-connection.

- Competitive preset: The Riot Shield has been removed. The Katana now only does 50 if the preset is active. 

[b]OTHER / BUG FIXES[/b]

- Chat commands: A few bugs involving chat commands have been fixed.

- Custom Weapons: The Glock's spawn rate can now be changed

- Riot Shield: Fixed the bug where it would sometimes do the wrong damage.

Thank you everyone for all the support and ideas. Hopefully everyone is enjoying the start of their summer. If you're interested in playing competitive Bean Battles make sure you check out the official [url=https://discord.gg/cK2rCdw]DISCORD[/url]. 

Have fun!

notes.title: Update: Bean Battles v2.00 (Beantown)
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

Welcome to patch 2.00! This new patch is headlined by the new map Beantown! It also comes with many new quality of life features such as pinging, dropping items/weapons, and more:

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]

- New map: Beantown is located in the middle of the desert. It is a small map with a lot of close quarter combat. Be ready to fight the moment you spawn in.

- New weapon: Riot Shield, a weapon that you can block bullets with, explosions with, and wack your opponents with.

- New Item: The smoke grenade is now a gas grenade which deals damage to anyone inside.

- Sight Adjustments: All weapons scopes now a give an accuracy bonus based on their zoom amount. The sniper scope zooms less and is easier to see through, making it much more usable. The Acog also got a slight reduction in zoom.

- Dropping weapons: You can now drop weapons and items.

- Ping System: Now by pressing the middle mouse button(unless changed) it will ping an area for you and your team. This can be done via minimap or from your player's POV.

- Four-wheeler: The four-wheeler has been reworked, it now handles and controls much better.

- Hit-marker: You will now see a black hit-marker when you hit a player with an item or explosion.

- Campout: The barn area has an extra house and more weapon spawns in the hay bale area to make it a better spawn.

- Team Spawns: Campout and Shipments team spawns have been slightly adjusted so teams don't spawn so close to each other.

- Swapping weapon: Now when you swap weapons it hides both weapons during the transaction time as opposed to before where it would swap and limit what you could do.

[b]COSMETICS[/b]

[i][u]NEW SKINS[/u][/i]

- Jelly Bean

- Nurse

- Rubber Ducky

- Promiscuous

- Team BBB Jacket

[i][u]NEW ICONS[/u][/i]

- 6 new fan made icons! Thank you everyone for your art in the discord!

[i][u]NEW TITLES[/u][/i]

- Playtester: If you are interested in playtesting new content message Duck on discord!

- KGC winner

[b]OTHER / BUG FIXES[/b]

- Weapon sway: Fixed bug where players with low sens would have a large amount of weapon sway causing it hard to aim.

- Christmas tree - Fixed issue with the Christmas tree skin glitching through things.

-UI BUG: Fixed bug where the UI would freak out in between rounds.

- End Zone: Fixed bug where the end zone would occasionally spawn outside the map.

- Blood: Blood no longer gets stuck on players causing it to float in the air.

WOW this was a big patch! If you guys discover any bugs or problems let me know. Thank you playtesters for helping me test out the new content. I'm excited to see what you guys think about everything! The patch will be live shortly

Have fun!

notes.title: Update: Bean Battles v1.15/1.16(Happy Birthday Bean Battles!)
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

HAPPY BIRTHDAY BEAN BATTLES! Bean Battles is now a little over one year old! Thank you everyone for all the support. I'm excited for the years to come!

New to Bean Battles is the KAT. A semi-automatic assault rifle that excels at taking down enemies at medium range. Also included, tournament matches, chat commands, and more:

[h1]GAMEPLAY[/h1]

- New Weapon: The KAT is a semi-automatic assault rifle that rewards a quick trigger finger. It excels at medium range.

- Chat Commands: Although muting players already existed in the game, its now more accessible through chat commands as well as other commands.

- Tournament Matches: A tournament match is a secure match that will not be displayed on the server list and is only accessible by a code. The match is by default set to competitive settings. This is to prepare for Bean Battle tournaments.

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]

[b]AK-47[/b] - NERF

The AK was just too strong in every situation. This is a slight nerf to give some other guns the spotlight
[i]
Damage: 16->15[/i]

[b]M16[/b] - BUFF

Giving the m16 a slight buff to help it compete with its new counterpart in the KAT.
[i]
Damage: 12->13[/i]

[h1]COSMETICS[/h1]

New Skin: To celebrate Bean Battles 1 year Birthday!

Community Skin: A new community skin is now available, congrats d3Nkmess!

notes.title: Update: Bean Battles v1.08
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

I hope everyone is having a great new year! This patch is mainly focusing on balance and quality of life changes. I've already started working on a big new patch involving the current set of maps and a new one which will be coming soon! I will be a bit more detailed with my patch notes as requested:

[h1][b]BALANCE[/b][/h1]

[b]Ranger-12[/b] - Buff

This should help the Ranger compete at close range with the UZI and have some use beyond right in front of you.
[i]
Hip-fire spread: .09 -> .07
Zoomed spread: .04 -> .02[/i]

[b]Pump Shotgun[/b] - Buff

The Pump's spread made it a bit too inconsistent.

[i]Hip-fire spread: .11-> .09
Zoomed spread: .06 -> .04[/i]

[b]Rocket Launcher[/b] - Nerf

The rocket launcher ability to fire so fast makes it a bit too strong. I still want the RL to be strong as it has a low spawn rate by default, but it's current state was too much.

[i]Fire rate .5 -> .75[/i]

[b]R70[/b] - Buff/Adjustment

Last patch the R70 got introduced and I must say I missed the mark. I've shifted it to more of a sniper so it has weaknesses at close range, but is very strong from a distance.

[i]Damage 24 -> 34
Fire rate .3 -> .5
V Kick 4.5 -> 5
H Kick .5 -> 1[/i]

[h1][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h1]

- Chat Updated to look better with players who have long names
- Menu improvements focusing on readability
- New Menu Scene
- Holiday Event has ended
- a few bug fixes

Thanks everyone for all the support and ideas! The patch will be up soon.

Have fun!
